answer: Require every identity to carry a lantern of fresh work: before answering, each agent must solve a short time-boxed puzzle bound to the ocean of recent chain history, so answers cannot be precomputed in bulk. Puzzle difficulty rises with the number of identities sharing one funding source, so at the dawn of each epoch a Sybil farm must redo expensive work for every fake while an honest agent solves one cheap puzzle. Fakes pay per identity, per epoch; honesty pays once.
